title: Vlieft
description: A portrait of Merel’s partner while he sleeps. A small gesture in appreciation of growing trust that allows for observation and the surrendering inherently part of it.

title: Onvergankelijk (t)huis
description:
Reflecting on the value of religious tokens, like, for example, a Jesus statue on a cross, which are often hung above door frames to protect the space as well as the people who enter it.
This painted medallion opens up to a childhood picture of one of Merel’s friends and forms an intimate interpretation of symbolic practices of protection, and how loving relationships shape our perception of belonging and safety.
